title: ApiSpend: metered API and agent-traffic cost governance for software teams

problem_severity_frequency.rationale: Metered API and agent-traffic cost pain is inferred from a vendor primary (Autodesk pricing from 2026-08-17), industry commentary and one unverifiable operator diary; no buyer-specific frequency or budget evidence. Capped at 2 (plausible but undemonstrated).

buyer_budget_clarity.rationale: Buyer assumed (engineering/finance leads at 20-200 staff software firms) but no evidence anyone buys a standalone tool for this job. Capped at 2.

evidence_strength.rationale: One vendor primary plus weak secondary/opinion sources; no primary evidence about this buyer or market.

differentiation.rationale: No defensible wedge: per-integration/per-agent attribution, budgets, quotas and chargeback are standard API-gateway and FinOps functionality already marketed by WSO2 AI Gateway, Moesif, Workato Enterprise MCP, Arcade and n8n. Direct incumbents contest the position, so capped at 2.

economics.rationale: Self-serve price and support load unmodelled; modelled economics on untested inputs are capped at 2 with low confidence.

economic_buyer.note: Buyer assumed (engineering/finance leads at 20-200 staff software firms); no evidence anyone buys a standalone tool for this job.
economic_buyer.resolve_via: Interviews with 5 target teams about current API-cost tooling and spend.

painful_frequent_or_budgeted.note: Repricing pain is documented mainly in vendor/opinion sources and one unverifiable diary; no buyer-specific frequency or budget evidence.
painful_frequent_or_budgeted.resolve_via: Buyer interviews plus review of gateway/observability renewal spend.

non_paid_distribution.note: Developer content, open-source and community channels are plausible but no prospects or channel evidence.
non_paid_distribution.resolve_via: One content or open-source launch measured for qualified inbound.

defensible_wedge.note: Metering, attribution, quota and chargeback are standard gateway/FinOps functionality and multiple vendors already market the position (Moesif per-agent attribution; WSO2 AI Gateway token budgets; Workato Enterprise MCP; Arcade; n8n).

no_network_effects_needed.note: A single-tenant tool may be useful alone, but value may depend on aggregated benchmark data.

plausible_margins.note: Self-serve price and support load unmodelled.

acceptable_risk.note: Reading customer API traffic raises telemetry, privacy and security exposure.
acceptable_risk.resolve_via: Security review of a minimal-scope design.

cheap_disconfirming_test.note: A zero-cost desk competitive scan was sufficient to disconfirm the wedge this run.

not_all_optimistic.note: Viability rests on several untested assumptions (buyer, price, channel).
not_all_optimistic.resolve_via: Name and test the weakest assumption first.
